title: VoltageDroopControl
description: Supplemental attribute for a voltage droop controller (PSS/E voltage droop control): a set of generators jointly regulating the reactive power at one bus along a Q–V characteristic. While the controller is available its regulated bus overrides each member's own target and their voltage setpoints are ignored; while it is unavailable the members fall back to their own targets. Membership and each member's relative reactive power weight are VoltageControlAssociation rows. The characteristic holds `reactive_power_limits.max` below `voltage_limits.min`, ramps to `deadband_reactive_power` at `deadband_voltage_limits.min`, holds it through `deadband_voltage_limits.max`, ramps to `reactive_power_limits.min` at `voltage_limits.max`, and holds it above.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this supplemental attribute.

name.description: Name of the voltage droop controller.

available.description: Whether the controller is in service (PSS/E STATUS). While false, members regulate their own targets.

regulated_bus_id.description: ID of the bus whose reactive power the controller regulates; overrides every member's own regulated bus while the controller is available.

reactive_power_limits.description: Reactive power held below `voltage_limits.min` (max, PSS/E QMAX) and above `voltage_limits.max` (min, PSS/E QMIN). Units: MVAr.

deadband_reactive_power.description: Reactive power held while the regulated bus voltage is inside `deadband_voltage_limits` (PSS/E QDB). Must lie strictly between `reactive_power_limits.min` and `reactive_power_limits.max`. Units: MVAr.

voltage_units.description: Unit basis for the voltage fields. COMPONENT_BASE (per-unit on the regulated bus base voltage) is PSS/E RAW native.

deadband_voltage_limits.description: Voltage band inside which the controller holds `deadband_reactive_power` (PSS/E VDBLOW, VDBHIGH). Must lie inside `voltage_limits`. Units: per voltage_units — NATURAL_UNITS: kV, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

voltage_limits.description: Voltages at which the characteristic reaches `reactive_power_limits.max` (min, PSS/E VLOW) and `reactive_power_limits.min` (max, PSS/E VHIGH). Units: per voltage_units — NATURAL_UNITS: kV, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .
